cards.title: Three choices
points: Czech has no a / an / the

rows: I visited her in the hospital.
The school needs a new roof.
The university is near the park.
The cat is on the bed.
I left my bag at the office.
The dogs next door are noisy.
the Czech Republic, the UK, the USA
the Alps, the Tatras, the Himalayas
the Danube, the Vltava, the Thames

cards.title: Unique

rows: the sun · the police · the internet
the manager · the doctor on duty

points: A job as one of many takes a / an: She is a teacher.

cards.title: Which article?
labels: A name on the map or the calendar, or a fixed case?
Use the pattern: the Danube · Prague · August · the piano · the news
In general: any, all, or the activity?
zero: Dogs are friendly · Life is hard · in hospital · breakfast
Do you both know which one, or is there only one?
the: the dog next door · the sun · the best
One thing: a / an. Some things: nothing. a dog · dogs · a teacher
points: Ask what the listener knows: new, known, or in general.
